quick_facts.sprint_goal: Build the product catalog + frontend scaffold. Cashiers can manage SKUs with VNĐ pricing and VAT rates.

content.tldr: Sprint 2 CLOSED. Product catalog backend (13 tests) + frontend scaffold complete. Login, product list, create/edit form all done. Vite build clean. Sprint 3 unblocked: Orders.
content.sprint_notes: Sprint 2 CLOSED 2026-04-12. Velocity 2/2. Product backend + frontend complete. BUG-0003 (critical, fixed): TransformInterceptor envelope not unwrapped — all auth + product API calls were broken. Fixed in api-client.ts response interceptor. BUG-0001 (medium, fixed) + BUG-0002 (high, fixed) from Sprint 1.

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Sprint 1 planned. Features auth + store committed. Roadmap through Sprint 3 defined.

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 1 officially closed. Velocity 2/2. 15 tasks done, 2 bugs fixed, 11 tests green, build passing. active_features cleared. blocked_features updated (product now unblocked). Sprint 2 queued.

audit.author: vibe-backend-nestjs
audit.note: Sprint 1 backend fully implemented. Auth module: JWT access (15m) + refresh (7d, Redis rotation), bcryptjs cost 12, no-enumeration 401 (BR-AUTH-08), RolesGuard, JwtAuthGuard + @Public bypass. Stores module: taxCode immutable, soft-delete, deactivate flushes Redis sessions. 2 migrations, admin seed. Build passing, 11 tests green. API contracts approved.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: BUG-0003 (critical) created and fixed. TransformInterceptor { data, meta } envelope was not unwrapped by frontend api-client.ts. All login attempts stored undefined tokens; RequireAuth bounced every user back to /login. Fixed with response interceptor + refresh-token path unwrap.
